Projects from $20,000. Fixed-price. Full IP. 24-hour response.

sections.title: Government Healthcare Analytics (Centene Corporation)
sections.description: Centene Corporation (Clayton MO HQ) — the US's largest Medicaid managed care organization.

blocks.heading: Medicaid population health at scale
paragraphs: ML for Centene's 27M+ Medicaid member population across 30 states — chronic disease identification, SDOH (social determinants of health) risk stratification, and care management prioritization for a patient population that is the most Medicaid-diverse in the US by state and demographic composition.

blocks.heading: Medicaid utilization management ML
paragraphs: ML for Centene's prior authorization and utilization management programs — predicting which utilization requests represent clinically appropriate care vs. potentially avoidable services for the Medicaid managed care organizations that must manage medical loss ratios under state contract requirements.

blocks.heading: Quality metrics and HEDIS performance analytics
paragraphs: ML for the healthcare quality measurement that drives Centene's Star ratings and value-based contract performance — HEDIS measure prediction, care gap closure prioritization, and the quality analytics that determine Centene's profitability across its large state contract portfolio.

sections.title: Healthcare Clinical AI (SSM Health and BJC HealthCare)
sections.description: SSM Health (St. Louis HQ) and BJC HealthCare (St. Louis HQ, Washington University Medical Center).

blocks.heading: BJC/WashU academic medical research AI
paragraphs: ML for the clinical research programs at Barnes-Jewish Hospital and the Siteman Cancer Center — Washington University's NCI-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center creates clinical trial analytics and oncology precision medicine ML demand.

blocks.heading: Missouri Medicaid analytics
paragraphs: Population health ML for the managed care organizations serving Missouri's MO HealthNet Medicaid program in the St. Louis market.

blocks.heading: BJC occupational health analytics
paragraphs: ML for BJC's large occupational health programs serving Missouri's large manufacturing and industrial employee base.

sections.title: Agricultural Commodity Analytics (Bunge)
sections.description: Bunge Limited (St. Louis HQ) — the world's largest oilseed processor and a top global grain trader.

blocks.heading: Crop yield and harvest prediction
paragraphs: ML for Bunge's procurement analytics — predicting soybean, corn, sunflower, and canola crop yields in the major agricultural geographies where Bunge procures crops (US Midwest, South America, Black Sea) for the trading and origination decisions that drive Bunge's commercial performance.

blocks.heading: Agricultural supply chain analytics
paragraphs: ML for Bunge's complex global processing and logistics network — optimizing the flow of agricultural commodities from origination through processing to end-market delivery for the oilseed processing operations that represent Bunge's core business.

sections.title: Edward Jones Financial Services
sections.description: Edward Jones (Maryland Heights MO HQ, adjacent St. Louis) — the US's largest retail brokerage by number of branches.

blocks.heading: Financial adviser practice analytics
paragraphs: ML for Edward Jones's 15,000+ financial advisers — practice productivity prediction, client life event detection, and the succession planning analytics for the financial adviser community that Edward Jones manages as a distributed network of 15,000+ largely independent offices.

blocks.heading: Client retention and relationship analytics
paragraphs: ML for client attrition prediction at the adviser level for Edward Jones's large retirement-oriented client base.

sections.title: Missouri AI regulatory context
sections.description: Key regulatory considerations for AI development in Missouri.

blocks.heading: Missouri data privacy landscape
paragraphs: Missouri has been considering but not yet enacted comprehensive consumer data privacy legislation as of 2025 — organizations should monitor the Missouri legislature for developments.

blocks.heading: CFTC for Bunge's trading operations
paragraphs: Bunge's commodity trading is subject to CFTC oversight — the analytics ClickMasters builds for Bunge's trading functions are designed with CFTC regulatory awareness.
